part2.cueCard: Describe a person who has influenced you in an important way.
bullets: and explain why they have influenced you
followUp: Do you still see this person often?
Do you think you have influenced anyone yourself?

part2.cueCard: Describe a place you visited that made a strong impression on you.
bullets: and explain why it made such a strong impression on you
followUp: Would you like to go back there?
Have you recommended this place to other people?

part2.cueCard: Describe an object you own that is important to you.
bullets: and explain why it is important to you
followUp: Would you be upset if you lost it?
Do you think you will keep it for a long time?

part2.cueCard: Describe a celebration or event that you particularly enjoyed.
bullets: where and when it took place
and explain why you enjoyed it so much
followUp: Do you often attend events like this?
Is there an event you are looking forward to?

part2.cueCard: Describe a skill or activity you learned that has been useful to you.
bullets: what the skill or activity is
when and how you learned it
and explain why it has been useful to you
followUp: Would you recommend other people learn this skill?
Is there another skill you would like to learn?

part2.cueCard: Describe a film or television programme that you found particularly interesting.
bullets: when and where you watched it
and explain why you found it so interesting
followUp: Have you watched it more than once?
Do you usually watch this kind of programme?

part2.cueCard: Describe a piece of technology that you find useful in your daily life.
bullets: what the piece of technology is
and explain why you find it useful
followUp: Could you manage without it?
Is there a newer version of it you would like to have?

part2.cueCard: Describe a journey that you remember well.
bullets: and explain why you remember this journey
followUp: Do you prefer long journeys or short ones?
What do you usually do to pass the time during a journey?

part2.cueCard: Describe a book that you enjoyed reading.
bullets: why you decided to read it
and explain why you enjoyed it
followUp: Do you read more or less than you used to?
Would you recommend this book to other people?

part2.topic: A change you made in your life
part2.cueCard: Describe a change you made that had a positive effect on your life.
bullets: why you decided to make it
and explain how it had a positive effect on you
followUp: Was it difficult to make this change?
Do you think people generally find change easy or difficult?

part2.cueCard: Describe a time when you helped somebody with something.
bullets: and explain why you decided to help
followUp: Was it easy to help them?
Do you often help people in this way?

part2.cueCard: Describe a rule at your school, your workplace or your home that you think is sensible.
bullets: what happens if somebody breaks it
and explain why you think the rule is sensible
followUp: Do you find this rule easy to follow?
Would you change anything about it?

part2.cueCard: Describe an animal that you find interesting.
bullets: how you first learned about it
and explain why you find this animal interesting
followUp: Have you ever seen this animal in real life?
Are these animals common where you live?

part2.topic: A time you had to wait
part2.cueCard: Describe a time when you had to wait for something.
bullets: what you did while you waited
and explain how you felt while you were waiting
followUp: Do you often have to wait where you live?
Is there anything that makes waiting easier for you?

part2.topic: Something you want to do in the future
part2.cueCard: Describe something you would like to do in the next few years.
bullets: what you would like to do
when you first thought of it
what you will need in order to do it
and explain why you want to do it
followUp: Have you told anyone about this plan?
Do you think you will do it soon?

part2.cueCard: Describe something you do that is better for the environment.
bullets: how easy or difficult it is
and explain why you think it makes a difference
followUp: Do the people around you do the same thing?
Is there anything else you would like to start doing?

part2.cueCard: Describe a time when you did something together with a group of people.
bullets: what your own part in it was
and explain why it was better to do it together than alone
followUp: Was anything difficult about working as a group?
Do you usually prefer working on your own?

part2.cueCard: Describe a day when you were very busy.
bullets: and explain how you felt at the end of the day
followUp: Are your days usually as busy as that?
Would you like to be less busy?

part2.cueCard: Describe something you do to keep yourself healthy.
bullets: and explain why you think it keeps you healthy
followUp: Is it easy to keep this up?
Did someone suggest it to you?

part2.cueCard: Describe a time when you had to speak in front of a group of people.
bullets: and explain how you felt while you were speaking
followUp: Do you have to do this often?
Was it easier than you expected?
